d: Nishant Kumar JDU Leadership : bihar ki rajniti men JDU ke bhavishy ko lekar bara bayan samne aaya hai... parti ke rashtriy karyakari adhyaksh sanjay jha ne nishant kumar ko lekar saph sandesh diya hai ki aane vale samay men parti unke netritv men kam karegi... sanjay jha ne kaha ki mantri kaun hai, upmukhyamantri kaun hai ya kiske pas kaun sa vibhag hai, yah dekhne ki jarurat nahin hai... parti ko nishant kumar ke netritv men aage barhna hai... unhonne nishant ke netritv men agle 30 varshon tak JDU ka bhavishy ujjval rahne ki bat bhi kahi
